create_AllScAIPConfigs: create an AllScAIPConfigs dataclass instance with nested global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization config objects
create_GlobalConfigs: create a GlobalConfigs dataclass to set model hyperparameters like hidden size, num layers, and activation function
create_MolecularGraphConfigs: create a MolecularGraphConfigs dataclass to configure KNN graph construction, cutoff radius, and chunked graph settings
init_configs: initialize a nested AllScAIPConfigs dataclass from a flat dictionary of keyword arguments with defaults
